name: Bamboo Joint Glass Cup with Lid & Straw | 13oz Can-Shaped Tumbler with Leather Sleeve
description:
Enjoy your favorite beverages in style with the Bamboo Joint Glass Cup with Lid & Straw (13oz) — a perfect blend of elegance, durability, and practicality. Designed with a protective leather sleeve and a bamboo lid, this can-shaped glass tumbler keeps your drinks secure, fresh, and spill-free whether you’re at home, in the office, or on the go.Crafted from high borosilicate glass, it’s lightweight, heat-resistant, and tasteless, ensuring your drink’s flavor stays pure.  13oz can-shaped glass for stylish drink serving

 High borosilicate glass – heat-resistant & durable

 Pour your favorite drink into the glass.
